kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنصرف (form VII)
# أَنْصَرِفُ (ʔanṣarifu) /ʔan.sˤa.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْصَرَفَ (inṣarafa)
# أَنْصَرِفَ (ʔanṣarifa) /ʔan.sˤa.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْصَرَفَ (inṣarafa)
# أَنْصَرِفْ (ʔanṣarif) /ʔan.sˤa.rif/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْصَرَفَ (inṣarafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
